text: Jackson update: a power failure. We're dark from Friday Mar 26 through Tuesday Mar 30; the line restarts the following working day.
summary: E-11 is Plant outage. 9 production orders move (6 rescheduled, 3 transferred). 36 dealer notice(s) and 17 loaner assignment(s).
reasoning: Walked Plant P_MS → production orders scheduled 2027-03-26 through 2027-03-30 inclusive. 9 orders cannot build during the outage. The line restarts 2027-03-31. Rule 2 and rule 3. Placed 6 at the same plant and transferred 3. Rule 4: 36 dealer notice(s), one each, listing only affected customer orders. Rule 5: 17 loaner(s) for Platinum and Gold in priority order; 1 entitled order(s) left without a car because the pool ran out. Standard customers are on the dealer notice only. Guardrail: only orders, vehicles, dealers, and customers reached by the walk are touched. Shared slots and loaner pools are one board for the whole event, so a compound message cannot double-book them.

handoffs.did: Split the message into 1 incident(s) and dispatched specialists.
